import type { Scene, SceneOptions } from '../../src/engine/types';
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const clamp = (v: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
const smooth = (v: number) => { v = clamp(v); return v * v * (3 - 2 * v); };
const point = (t: number) => ({ x: 450 + 6400 * smooth(t / 24), y: 540 + Math.sin(t * .72) * 150 + Math.sin(t * 1.17) * 35 });
export function createScene({ width, height }: SceneOptions): Scene {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = width; canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); if (!ctx) throw new Error('2D canvas unavailable');
  const c = ctx;
  const ring = (x: number, y: number, r: number, color: string, line = 2) => { c.strokeStyle = color; c.lineWidth = line; c.beginPath(); c.arc(x, y, Math.max(0, r), 0, TAU); c.stroke(); };
  const dot = (x: number, y: number, r: number, color: string) => { c.fillStyle = color; c.beginPath(); c.arc(x, y, Math.max(0, r), 0, TAU); c.fill(); };
  return { canvas, render(time) {
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(24, time)), p = point(t), camera = Math.max(0, Math.min(5440, p.x - 700));
    c.setTransform(width / 1920, 0, 0, height / 1080, 0, 0); c.globalAlpha = 1; c.shadowBlur = 0;
    const bg = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 1920, 1080); bg.addColorStop(0, '#07162a'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#03070f'); c.fillStyle = bg; c.fillRect(0, 0, 1920, 1080);
    // A single continuous world; the camera follows the same signal through every mechanism.
    c.save(); c.translate(-camera * .22, 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < 190; i++) { const x = (i * 137.53) % 3400, y = (i * i * 47.7) % 1080; dot(x, y, 1 + (i % 3) * .45, `rgba(131,190,217,${.12 + .1 * Math.sin(t + i) ** 2})`); }
    c.restore(); c.save(); c.translate(-camera, 0);
    c.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let row = 0; row < 9; row++) {
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(58,124,160,.13)'; c.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= 150; i++) { const x = i * 50, y = 150 + row * 100 + Math.sin(x / 300 + row) * 22; if (i === 0) c.moveTo(x, y); else c.lineTo(x, y); } c.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) ring(450, 540, 55 + i * 42 + Math.sin(t * 2.5 - i) * 5, `rgba(87,226,244,${.4 - i * .075})`, 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const a = i / 12 * TAU + t * .2; dot(450 + Math.cos(a) * 222, 540 + Math.sin(a) * 222, 5, '#74deed'); }
    // Lens gates open with a damped overshoot as the moving signal approaches.
    for (let gate = 0; gate < 5; gate++) {
      const x = 1800 + gate * 175, travel = clamp((p.x - x + 330) / 650), settle = 1 + .12 * Math.sin(travel * 11) * Math.exp(-travel * 3);
      c.save(); c.translate(x, 540); c.scale(.35 + .07 * gate, settle);
      ring(0, 0, 210 + gate * 12, `rgba(99,218,240,${.3 + .55 * Math.sin(travel * Math.PI)})`, 5);
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i / 16 * TAU + t * .3; dot(Math.cos(a) * 230, Math.sin(a) * 230, 3, '#efbd70'); } c.restore();
    }
    // Branching conductors progressively respond, then converge into one moving pulse.
    for (let row = 0; row < 7; row++) {
      const y = 235 + row * 100;
      c.strokeStyle = '#163c53'; c.lineWidth = 4; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(2850, 540); c.bezierCurveTo(3060, 540, 3070, y, 3300, y); c.lineTo(3850, y); c.bezierCurveTo(4080, y, 4150, 540, 4350, 540); c.stroke();
      for (let col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
        const x = 3320 + col * 170, on = Math.exp(-(((p.x - x) / 450) ** 2));
        ring(x, y, 17 + on * 7, `rgba(116,233,223,${.2 + on * .8})`, 3); dot(x, y, 5 + on * 4, on > .15 ? '#b0fff2' : '#254657');
      }
      const q = ((t * .42 + row * .12) % 1), x = 2950 + q * 1300, envelope = Math.sin(q * Math.PI);
      dot(x, 540 + (y - 540) * envelope, 4, '#f3c682');
    }
    // Orbiting nodes arrive at a connected constellation instead of a static end card.
    const center = 6150, arrival = smooth((t - 15) / 7);
    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
      const a = i * 2.399963 + t * .12, r = 72 + Math.sqrt(i) * 47;
      const x = center + Math.cos(a) * r, y = 540 + Math.sin(a) * r * .82;
      c.strokeStyle = `rgba(73,177,197,${.10 + arrival * .15})`; c.lineWidth = 1.3; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(center, 540); c.lineTo(x, y); c.stroke();
      dot(x, y, 4 + Math.sin(t * 2 + i) ** 2 * 3, i % 5 ? '#6ccedb' : '#ffc980');
    }
    ring(center, 540, 370 + Math.sin(t) * 8, 'rgba(126,232,235,.22)', 2);
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) { c.save(); c.translate(center, 540); c.rotate(j * Math.PI / 3 + t * .10); c.scale(1, .36); ring(0, 0, 350, 'rgba(115,233,228,.25)', 2); c.restore(); }
    // Every trail point is reconstructed from absolute time: cold seeks and reverse seeks are identical.
    for (let i = 56; i >= 0; i--) {
      const q = point(Math.max(0, t - i * .016)); const alpha = (1 - i / 57) ** 2;
      dot(q.x, q.y, 2 + alpha * 7, `rgba(103,243,240,${alpha * .68})`);
    }
    c.shadowBlur = 32; c.shadowColor = '#79fff2'; dot(p.x, p.y, 12, '#d5fff6'); c.shadowBlur = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) ring(p.x, p.y, 22 + ((t * 55 + i * 28) % 84), `rgba(140,249,244,${.20 * (1 - ((t * 55 + i * 28) % 84) / 84)})`);
    c.restore();
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(182,219,230,.75)'; c.font = '500 20px sans-serif'; c.fillText('SIGNAL / A CONTINUOUS JOURNEY', 72, 72);
    const fade = 1 - smooth((t - 2) / 2); c.globalAlpha = fade; c.fillStyle = '#e6f6f6'; c.font = '600 56px sans-serif'; c.fillText('一束光的旅程', 760, 270); c.globalAlpha = 1;
    // Keep subtitle safe area free of important subjects.
    const vignette = c.createLinearGradient(0, 900, 0, 1080); vignette.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(3,7,15,0)'); vignette.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(3,7,15,.88)'); c.fillStyle = vignette; c.fillRect(0, 900, 1920, 180);
  }, dispose() { canvas.width = 1; canvas.height = 1; } };
}
